milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining blue_terracotta with a pickaxe drops the block item into the player's inventory. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined item directly appears in inventory. The player must mine at least 1 blue terracotta block from the wall at x=3 to create a passage to the back room.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The blue glazed terracotta blocks are at spawn-relative coordinates (7,0,3), (7,0,4), (8,0,3) on the floor of the back room. Target is set to the center of the cluster at (7,0,3). max_distance=5 ensures the player has entered the back room (only accessible after mining through the blue terracotta wall). facing_tolerance=75 accommodates looking downward at floor-level blocks while still confirming the player is genuinely observing them.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block) because this is a build/place task. The back room spans x=4-10, z=0-6 and has no ceiling (verified in sandbox). The ceiling should be at y=3 or y=4 (matching front room ceiling height). A generous box of x=3-10, y=3-4, z=-1-7 covers the ceiling area with ±1 buffer. Requiring at least 4 oak_planks blocks ensures a meaningful ceiling structure rather than a single accidental placement. The player has 64 oak planks which is more than sufficient.
